description: Set up the complete Supabase database schema for the Gambit social deduction game

acceptance_criteria: Enum created with values: 'lobby', 'playing', 'finished'
Can be used as column type in gambit_games table
Enum created with values: 'pending', 'team_selection', 'voting', 'in_progress', 'succeeded', 'failed'
Can be used for tracking round/phase state
Enum created with values: 'good', 'evil'
Can be used for team assignment

features.description: Create profiles table linked to auth.users
acceptance_criteria: Table created with columns: id (uuid, PK, references auth.users), email (text), display_name (text), created_at (timestamptz)
Trigger to auto-create profile on user signup
RLS enabled with policy for users to read/update own profile

features.description: Create gambit_games table for game state
acceptance_criteria: id: uuid PK with default gen_random_uuid()
game_key: varchar(8) UNIQUE NOT NULL for shareable join code
host_id: uuid NOT NULL references profiles(id)
status: gambit_game_status DEFAULT 'lobby'
phase: varchar(30) for current game phase
current_round: int DEFAULT 0
crown_index: int DEFAULT 0 for current leader
rejection_count: int DEFAULT 0
good_victories: int DEFAULT 0
evil_victories: int DEFAULT 0
selected_team: uuid[] for player IDs on current mission
winner: varchar(10) for 'good' or 'evil'
end_reason: varchar(100)
settings: jsonb DEFAULT '{}'
name: text for display name
created_at: timestamptz DEFAULT now()

features.description: Create gambit_players table for game participants
acceptance_criteria: id: uuid PK with default gen_random_uuid()
game_id: uuid NOT NULL references gambit_games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
user_id: uuid NOT NULL references profiles(id)
display_name: varchar(100)
character: varchar(50) for assigned character name
team: varchar(10) for 'good' or 'evil'
is_alive: boolean DEFAULT true
seat_order: int for position in turn order
created_at: timestamptz DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE constraint on (game_id, user_id)

features.description: Create gambit_game_actions table for audit log
acceptance_criteria: id: uuid PK with default gen_random_uuid()
game_id: uuid NOT NULL references gambit_games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
player_id: uuid references gambit_players(id)
action_type: varchar(50) NOT NULL (vote_yes, vote_no, assassinate, etc.)
target_ids: uuid[] for target player IDs
round: int for round when action occurred
phase: varchar(30) for phase when action occurred
metadata: jsonb DEFAULT '{}'
created_at: timestamptz DEFAULT now()

features.description: Create gambit_game_modifiers table for temporary game effects
acceptance_criteria: id: uuid PK with default gen_random_uuid()
game_id: uuid NOT NULL references gambit_games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
round: int NOT NULL for round this modifier applies to
modifier_type: varchar(50) NOT NULL (force_pass, extra_fail, etc.)
created_by: uuid references gambit_players(id)
metadata: jsonb DEFAULT '{}'
created_at: timestamptz DEFAULT now()

features.description: Create gambit_player_statuses table for temporary player effects
acceptance_criteria: id: uuid PK with default gen_random_uuid()
game_id: uuid NOT NULL references gambit_games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
player_id: uuid NOT NULL references gambit_players(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
status_type: varchar(50) NOT NULL (protected, beepered, etc.)
created_by: uuid references gambit_players(id)
metadata: jsonb DEFAULT '{}'
expires_at_round: int for when status expires
created_at: timestamptz DEFAULT now()
id: uuid PK with default gen_random_uuid()
game_id: uuid NOT NULL references gambit_games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
action: varchar(100) NOT NULL for event name
phase: varchar(30)
round: int
duration_ms: int for processing time
metadata: jsonb DEFAULT '{}'
created_at: timestamptz DEFAULT now()
Unique index created on game_key column
Lookups by game_key are fast

features.description: Create composite index on gambit_players(game_id, user_id)
acceptance_criteria: Composite index created
Lookups by game_id and user_id are optimized

features.description: Create composite index on gambit_game_actions(game_id, round, phase)
acceptance_criteria: Composite index created
Queries filtering by game, round, and phase are optimized

features.description: Create composite index on gambit_player_statuses(game_id, player_id, status_type)
acceptance_criteria: Composite index created
Lookups for player statuses are optimized
RLS enabled on profiles table
Users can read any profile (for display names)
Users can only update their own profile
RLS enabled on gambit_games table
Authenticated users can read games they are players in
Authenticated users can insert new games (become host)
Only host can update game state
Players in game can read game state
RLS enabled on gambit_players table
Players can read other players in same game
Users can insert themselves into games (join)
Users can only delete their own player record (leave)
Character and team visible only to own player or after game ends
RLS enabled on gambit_game_actions table
Players in game can read actions (for vote counts)
Players can only insert actions for themselves
RLS enabled on gambit_game_modifiers table
Players in game can read modifiers
Only server/host can insert modifiers
RLS enabled on gambit_player_statuses table
Players can read their own statuses
Status creators can read statuses they created

Vote submissions broadcast in real-time
